title: X1E Asus Zenbook A14 support
commit_message:
X1E Asus Zenbook A14 support

Depends on kernel change:
https://code.launchpad.net/~alexvinarskis/ubuntu/+source/linux/+git/linux/+merge/483642
diff:
diff --git a/debian/hwe-qcom-x1e-meta.modaliases b/debian/hwe-qcom-x1e-meta.modaliases
index 160b8e6..94619d2 100644
--- a/debian/hwe-qcom-x1e-meta.modaliases
+++ b/debian/hwe-qcom-x1e-meta.modaliases
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 alias dmi:bvnAcer:*:pnSwiftSF14-11* hwe-qcom-x1e-meta
 alias dmi:bvnASUSTeKCOMPUTERINC.:*:pnASUSVivobookS15* hwe-qcom-x1e-meta
+alias dmi:bvnASUSTeKCOMPUTERINC.:*:pnASUSZenbookA14* hwe-qcom-x1e-meta
 alias dmi:bvnDellInc.:*:pnXPS139345* hwe-qcom-x1e-meta
 alias dmi:bvnHP:*:pnHPOmniBookXLaptop14* hwe-qcom-x1e-meta
 alias dmi:bvnLENOVO:*:pvrThinkPadT14sGen6* hwe-qcom-x1e-meta
diff --git a/hooks/ubuntu-x1e-settings b/hooks/ubuntu-x1e-settings
index a1a69d8..2f5b61d 100755
--- a/hooks/ubuntu-x1e-settings
+++ b/hooks/ubuntu-x1e-settings
@@ -20,3 +20,9 @@ done
 for f in $(find /lib/firmware/updates/qcom/x1e80100 -type f); do
         add_firmware "${f#/lib/firmware/updates/}"
 done
+for f in $(find /lib/firmware/qcom/x1p42100 -type f); do
+        add_firmware "${f#/lib/firmware/}"
+done
+for f in $(find /lib/firmware/updates/qcom/x1p42100 -type f); do
+        add_firmware "${f#/lib/firmware/updates/}"
+done
